newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 18.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- The legal circles said reinvestigation in the Hanbo loan scandal inevitable.
- North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop expected to depart Beijing today to a third country, diplomatic sources said.
- North Korea said it will attend the four-way talks if food aid provided, diplomatic sources said.
- President Kim Young-sam's son Hyun-chul apologised to the nation.
- Foreign stock investment holdings are expected to be raised earlier than expected by 5 to 10 pecent annually until 1999.
